data.name: Key To The Town
data.description: Allows access to all buildings in town, at any time of day.

data.name: Price Catalogue
data.description: You can now see the value of your items.

data.name: Mapping Cave Systems
data.description: You get a 50% discount on Marlon's item retrieval service.

data.name: Way Of The Wind pt. 1
data.description: You run a little bit faster.

data.name: Way Of The Wind pt. 2
data.description: You run a little bit faster.

data.name: Monster Compendium
data.description: Monsters have a small chance to drop double loot.

data.name: Friendship 101
data.description: You become friends with people a little faster.

data.name: Jack Be Nimble, Jack Be Thick
data.description: Gain +1 Defense.

data.name: Woody's Secret
data.description: Felled trees have a 5% chance to yield double the wood.

data.name: Raccoon Journal
data.description: Weeds have a greater chance to yield mixed seeds.

data.name: Jewels Of The Sea
data.description: Fishing treasure chests have a chance to yield roe.

data.name: Dwarvish Safety Manual
data.description: Bombs deal 25% less damage to you.

data.name: The Art O' Crabbing
data.description: Crab pots have a 25% chance to yield double.

data.name: The Alleyway Buffet
data.description: You have a greater chance to find items in the trash.

data.name: The Diamond Hunter
data.description: All stones have a chance to drop a diamond when mined by hand.

data.name: Book of Mysteries
data.description: You have a slightly greater chance to find Mystery Boxes.

data.name: Horse: The Book
data.description: You gain a little extra speed when riding a horse.

data.name: Treasure Appraisal Guide
data.description: You will fetch a better price when selling artifacts.

data.name: Ol' Slitherlegs
data.description: You will now run a lot faster through grass and crops.

data.name: Animal Catalogue
data.description: You can access Marnie's shop when she's not around.

data.name: Farming Mastery
data.description: You can now find Golden Animal Crackers, which permanently doubles a farm animal's produce. Doesn't work on pigs.

data.name: Fishing Mastery
data.description: You can now encounter Golden Fishing Chests.

data.name: Foraging Mastery
data.description: You now find Golden Mystery Boxes, which contain superior items.

data.name: Mining Mastery
data.description: Gem-bearing rocks now grant twice the gems.

data.name: Combat Mastery
data.description: Unlocks a new equipment slot for trinkets. Trinkets can be found while adventuring and grant special powers.
